findings.source: resource_monitor.py monitor() finalization and run_stage.py main() final assessment
findings.observed_source_behavior: Elapsed is compared at the top of each monitoring loop. After the last comparison, stdout handling, process-exit detection and owned-process cleanup occur. Final elapsed_seconds is recorded before the final disk callback, but passed never compares this final elapsed to limits[total_seconds]. run_stage checks only the cumulative 900-second budget.
findings.impact: A successful worker and cleanup can produce a phase report whose own final elapsed exceeds the declared 120/600/60-second phase cap while still passing; the final disk callback is also excluded from recorded elapsed.
findings.bounded_correction: Measure final elapsed after owned cleanup and the final storage callback; reject complete/passed when this exceeds the unchanged phase total_seconds; preserve any earlier stop reason and the sealed initial version.
findings.reviewer_reproduction: Static control-flow finding only. No controller or probe was run. Owner acknowledged and is preparing a separate v2 with retained harmless delayed-finalization evidence.
